messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] eu-west-2: elevated 502/504 from ALB + increased latency for Hosted API and Dedicated pools. Impacting auth refreshes and upload paths. Pager: Ryan

Ryan: I'm on it. seeing spike in 502s from ALB in eu-west-2, backend nginx returning 504 on long-poll. Trying curl against health endpoint.

Sara: seeing STS token refresh errors in logs too — 500s from https://sts.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com around 12:01 UTC

Mike: Datadog ingestion is also throwing 5xx on our metrics-forwarder for the region. We have reduced visibility there.

Ryan: ok plan: 1) enable cross-region routing (fail eu-west-2 to eu-west-1/us-east-1) 2) temporarily increase dedicated pool capacity in eu-west-2 to absorb retries 3) disable long-polling feature for affected routes 4) update status page

Deepa: I can flip the routing. running:

``
redwoodctl routing set --region eu-west-2 --fallback eu-west-1,us-east-1 --weight 0.0
``

Josh: I'm scaling dedicated pools now: spinning up 4 x p4d-equivalents in eu-west-1 and binding reserved-pool fallbacks.

Mei: status page note drafted. putting 'partial outage in eu-west-2 affecting API latency and upload'.

Ryan: applied routing change at 12:06 UTC. Confirmed traffic shifted ~78% out of eu-west-2. ALB 502 rate trending down but still elevated for remaining traffic.

Sara: still seeing STS 500s sporadically; auth refresh is erroring for some sessions — adding retries in auth proxy (short term patch).

Mike: Datadog still missing some metrics. added alternative metrics sink to BigQuery for critical autoscale signals.

Anna-ops: Customer-facing comms prepared. Sending to SLAs that have Dedicated pools in eu-west-2.

Ryan: paging loop: I'm staying on until 12:45 UTC then handing off to Deepa. calling pager rotation now.

incident-bot: Reminder: incident channel created #inc-eu-west-2-fallback. All updates there.

Deepa: taking over. next steps: keep routing fallback, monitor error budget, coordinate with AWS support. Opening AWS support case with full logs and timeline.

Josh: logs attached to support case (S3 link) and we included ALB/ELB request traces + nginx upstream 504s.

Mei: status updated to 'degraded' at 12:15 UTC. will update every 30m or on major change.

Deepa: AWS support acknowledges region-level issue, says they're investigating control plane for ALB. ETA unknown. We'll keep failover routing active and monitor customers.

Sara: rolling auth proxy retry deployment now (5s backoff, 3 retries). should reduce token-related 5xx.

Ryan: handing off to Deepa at 12:45. keeping on-call notes briefed: routing fallback active, dedicated pools scaled, auth retries deployed, metrics sink active, support case #1234567890 open.

Deepa: received. I'll do 1h follow-up and coordinate postmortem. tagging @sara @mike @josh for follow-up items.

incident-bot: Incident severity set to Sev2. Please add any customer-impact statements to the thread.

Anna-ops: Notified 4 affected customers directly (emails queued). Template: 'We are experiencing elevated latency and 502/504s in eu-west-2; traffic has been routed to other regions. Investigating with AWS.'

Deepa: logging action items: - Confirm if any Dedicated contracts need credits - Verify autoscale thresholds changed - Collect sample traces for postmortem

Ryan: ETA for full restore depends on AWS. good work team. handing off complete. :thumbsup:

Mei: closing the pager for me. will stay on watch for status page edits.
